questions.question: What is the source of truth for cost claims?
questions.answer: Receipts, provider metadata when available, local measurements, or UNKNOWN_NOT_INSTRUMENTED.

questions.question: Can local PASS coexist with global caps?
questions.answer: Yes, if caps are carried separately and do not block local scope.

questions.question: What makes savings fake?
questions.answer: Any reduction that removes authority, receipts, evidence, source links, checksums, or red-team.
